title: (No AI) Meta’s Muse AI can create custom ‘spaces’ for the version of the app you need right now
author: Emma Roth
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/meta-muse-spaces.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=8.0752843063528,0,91.924715693647,74.471659887186)

Meta will now allow you to build customized, app-like experiences within its Muse AI assistant. The [new feature, called "spaces,"](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/11/introducing-spaces-customize-muse-app/) allows Muse to build things like a shopping hub, school dashboard, music tracker, trivia game, and more, which you can interact with directly in the app.

If you connect your space to a relevant app, Muse will update pricing, dates, and other information in the background. Meta says you can create a new space by describing it, and continue to tweak it by asking Muse. You can also interact with your spaces by checking things off, adding notes, and making edits.

[](https://www.threads.com/@muse/post/DfaNbz4CMU8)

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1028871/meta-muse-ai-spaces)

title: (No AI) AI is the new dating dealbreaker
author: Helen Li
content:
![a hand holding a phone open to a dating app with a robot as the profile picture](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/268841_When_it_comes_to_dating_is_AI_the_new_politics__CVirginia.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

When Irene moved to San Francisco last year, she started using dating apps as a way to meet new people, get to know her new city, and connect with others who care about the things she does. After the 25-year-old analyst downloaded Hinge and started swiping, she noticed a trend.

"Hinge has a prompt where you can say, 'We'll get along if''," she recalls. "Sometimes people will be like, 'Fuck AI.'"

Usually, the people who include this kind of value statement on their profile work in the arts, nursing, maybe graphic design. Within the span of a few minutes of sitting down and swiping, Irene shows me a second profile where this happened once mo …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1028609/ai-dating-feelings-doomers-singularity)
